title: Fiora · Six motion annotations
evidence: Read-only inspection of loaded public CSS/JS assets on the authenticated Magnific web app. No paid generation or workflow mutation was run. CSS timing and source constants are verified; complete frame-by-frame visual equivalence to an active Magnific generation is not claimed.

geometry.wireColorMapping: Magnific data-type colors are text #8566dc, image #6f8bf7; supplied Fiora design uses #198aff for both.
geometry.units: Scene CSS pixels at100% zoom. Legacy1440×1162 frame defines initial node coordinates only; the live viewport/canvas has no artboard boundary.
geometry.referenceAssets: Only discrete photo and font are used. UI is semantic HTML/SVG, not screenshot backgrounds.

animations.name: Connection draw + Disconnect
animations.trigger: Demo Connect or edge Disconnect; pointerdown on output starts live temporary cable
animations.summary: Vẽ đường từ source đến target; ngắt thì chạy ngược.
animations.parameters: Demo draw 600ms, offset L → 0; disconnect 600ms, offset 0 → L. Drag preview #1188FF / .45, width2, dash5 gap5, offset0 → -20 over500ms linear infinite. Manual commit switches immediately to a solid wire; it does not replay demo draw. Solid stroke3px #198AFF; length measured with getTotalLength().
animations.endpointRule: Use live port-center coordinates after drag, resize or zoom. path.getTotalLength() is authoritative; Magnific internally estimates 1.3 × endpoint distance.

dragPreview.repeat: infinite while pointer is down, even when demo timeline is paused
dragPreview.stop: pointerup, Escape or cancel; remove temporary path; valid committed cable is solid
dragPreview.provenance: Dashed moving temporary cable follows the supplied Magnific screenshot. Exact drag dash metrics are Fiora mapping; native drag timing was not measured.

animations.implementation: implemented; draw timeline and manual drag use different clocks
animations.exit: Release commits valid same-kind input; invalid drop / Escape / pointercancel / blur removes temporary cable and preserves prior connection.
animations.reducedMotion: Temporary dashes remain static. Demo draw switches immediately; graph disconnect retains its 600ms reverse draw.

animations.name: Target connector + inward ring & particle
animations.trigger: Live cable pointer is within58 screen px of nearest compatible input
animations.duration: 1300 ms / inward ring; continuous while target is nearby
animations.summary: Một vòng co nhẹ vào tâm; halo mờ và ít dot hơn.
animations.parameters: One ring only. radius=portScreenRadius+14*(1-phase)^2; opacity=sin(pi*phase)*.28; stroke1px #1188FF. Halo radius+12 at .025. Native26-particle pool; at most8 visible dots, groupopacity .65. Snap within28 screenpx.
animations.evidence: Magnific particle constants · user-requested inward rings

particlePhysics.acceleration: f=22000*(1+1.5*charge)/max(distance,4); acceleration adds radial + .35 tangential force. velocity *= exp(-2.5*dt).
particlePhysics.zoom: Live feedback SVG uses viewport CSS pixels; radii, dots and proximity thresholds do not scale with canvas zoom.
particlePhysics.integration: Magnific clamps frame dt to .05 s; prototype uses deterministic 1/120 s steps.
particlePhysics.spawnRadiusFormula: min=max(14,pointerDistance*.6), max=max(30,pointerDistance*1.1); uniform radius between min/max.

animations.exit: Clear overlay on target leave / release / Escape / cancel; reset particle seed on target change.
animations.reducedMotion: One static ring: radius+4, 1px #8FC7FF at .5; halo remains; no dots.
animations.implementation: implemented in live drag; old automatic timeline spark sample is separate reference playback
animations.previewSteps: Kéo output T đến gần input T (dưới58px màn hình); giữ chuột để xem 1 vòng co vào. Thả trong28px để nối.

configuration.particles: Native 26-particle pool; render at most 8 dots at .65 group opacity
configuration.reducedMotion: Static target ring, no moving rings or particles
configuration.cleanup: Clear on pointer leaving target, release, cancel or Escape

connectorStates.connected: border #8FC7FF, at least one attached edge; independent of full graph reachability
connectorStates.selected: border #1188FF only for connectors owned by clicked node
connectorStates.selection: Capture pointerdown on original or inserted nodes; click blank canvas/wire clears node selection

targetFeedback.particles: Native 26-particle pool; render at most 8 dots at .65 group opacity
targetFeedback.reducedMotion: Static target ring, no moving rings or particles
targetFeedback.cleanup: Clear on pointer leaving target, release, cancel or Escape

animations.notes: Live target behavior is1300ms/one ring/max8dots. Automatic Connect playback uses a legacy900ms pulse; use live drag for this annotation.

animations.name: Landing impact & split sweep
animations.summary: Cổng sáng lên, node giật nhẹ, hai vệt chạy quanh viền.
animations.parameters: Ring r10: scale .6 → 2.6, opacity 1 → 0. Core r6: 1.4 → .6, .9 → 0. Flash20px/.35 +2.5px core; recoil−8px/320ms. Split sweep650ms, normalized dash .22/2, offset .22→−.78, cubic(.33,0,.2,1), fade after75%.

recoil.composite: add; preserve any node drag transform

sweep.paths: Two rounded paths from the input Y around top/bottom to the opposite edge; radius16.

animations.exit: Remove impact after650ms; recoil returns to0 after320ms.
animations.reducedMotion: No impact ring/core/flash, sweep or recoil.
animations.implementation: implemented for original generator demo and original-output commit; inserted-node links are routing previews without per-node impact.

animations.name: Finishing border
animations.summary: Dải beam nở thành toàn bộ viền trước khi lộ ảnh.
animations.parameters: --segment-size .278 → 1. Keep color1 .056/.278 & color2 .167/.278 relative stop ratios. Colors #1188FF / #8FC7FF. Expand800ms ease-out while rotation continues4000ms linear from225deg. Border4px; outer radius20/inner16; glowblur20/.6. Interior remains white.
animations.exit: Demo reveals at9.2s. Production waits for real completion and decoded image; continue rotation phase instead of restarting.
animations.reducedMotion: Static outline; no segment expansion or spinning glow.

colors.provenance: User-selected Fiora palette, 2026-10-23. Magnific timing and gradient geometry are preserved; source default palette was #ff00aa / #00fff1.

animations.name: Image ready / reveal
animations.summary: Ảnh vào từ blur nhẹ đến rõ; không scale ảnh.
animations.readyGate: await image.decode(); never reveal incomplete images. Demo output reuses the source photo; no AI generation is run.
animations.exit: After500ms: opacity1, filter:none. Cancel exits to input state.
animations.reducedMotion: Show decoded image immediately, no blur/fade.
animations.implementation: implemented; bundled source image reused as demo result

animations.name: Wire interaction — Disconnect / Insert
animations.summary: Chọn dây để Delete; hover hoặc chuột phải mở menu thao tác.
animations.parameters: Hover/right-click opens Disconnect / Insert node. Click selects only. Disconnect removes chosen segment, keeps nodes/branches. Insert replaces chosen edge by source→new→target, supports repeated insertion, searchable10 types. Picker is screen-space, canvas unchanged by scroll inside picker.
animations.exit: Escape/outside click dismisses without graph change. Valid pick inserts then Fit. Empty search shows No nodes found.
animations.reducedMotion: No menu entry animation; disconnect retains600ms reverse draw.
animations.implementation: implemented graph/placement preview; inserted node operations have no AI backend

configuration.selection: Click selects wire; does not disconnect. Delete/Backspace removes selected connection; ignored in text fields.
configuration.menu: Hover 200ms or right-click opens Disconnect / Insert node. Escape / click outside dismisses.
configuration.disconnect: Only selected segment removed; 600ms reverse draw. Nodes retained; missing generator inputs disable Run.
configuration.insert: Searchable node picker with all 10 types from Figma. Choose creates draggable node and replaces selected edge with source → new node → target. Other branches retained.
configuration.graph: Supports repeated insertion, branch-specific removal, reachability checks, moving inserted nodes and reconnecting their output ports.
configuration.assets: Disconnect/search and picker icons exported from original Figma main components.
configuration.limits: Inserted nodes simulate routing and placement in the prototype; no AI backend execution.

menuAppearance.icons: Existing Fiora vector paths, duplicate disconnect path removed; menu-specific neutral plus

configuration.menuPosition: Anchor pointer viewport-relative; x=pointerX-24, y=pointerY-10; clamp min8/max(viewport-panel-8). Menu height138, maxHeight=viewportHeight-24.
configuration.insertPlacement: New node x=sceneAnchorX+70,y=sceneAnchorY-120; body380x380. Replace chosen edge by2 edges of same kind. Resolve overlapping downstream node, then Fit.

animations.previewSteps: Hover dây200ms hoặc chuột phải → Insert node → tìm Crop → chọn. Chỉ đoạn được chọn tách thành2 dây. Escape để hủy.
code: wire-interactions.js: showMenu(), close(), disconnect(), renderList(), insert(), reachable(), route()

animations.name: Connection success · dashed to solid
animations.trigger: Valid release on a compatible available input
animations.parameters: Fade dashed preview opacity .45→0 while solid3px draws source→target over320ms. Endpoint moves release point→input over160ms. Hide committed graph edge until overlay completes.
animations.exit: Overlay removed after320ms, committed edge becomes visible.

configuration.route: M ax ay C ax+h ay bx-h by bx by; h=clamp(.45*hypot(dx,dy),64,240)
configuration.cleanup: remove transient overlay and reveal committed graph edge at completion

animations.previewSteps: Kéo output vào thân node để thử; thả ra nền để xem thu dây.

animations.name: Soft curved wire routing
animations.trigger: Drawing, moving or inserting a connected node, or dragging a cable
animations.parameters: All routes use cubic Bézier: M ax ay C ax+h ay bx-h by bx by. h=clamp(.45*hypot(dx,dy),64,240) scene px. Horizontal endpoint tangents; round linecaps/joins. No orthogonal elbows.
animations.exit: Recompute from live endpoint centers on node move.
animations.previewSteps: Di chuyển node hoặc Insert node để xem đường dây cong mềm.

animations.name: Node-body drop · auto detect & retract
animations.trigger: Release anywhere inside a target node body, or within28 screen px of its input
animations.parameters: Whole380x380 body is a target. Choose same-kind free input, ignore existing edge from current source in occupancy check. Reject occupied input, self-link and directed cycles. Body hover activates target feedback. Invalid/cancel drop retracts source→pointer path by dashoffset0→L over260ms; retain prior graph.
animations.exit: Valid drop uses M16. Invalid/cancel clears preview after260ms; no graph mutation.

configuration.availability: same kind, no incoming edge from other source, no self/cycle

animations.previewSteps: Kéo output vào thân node để thử; thả ra nền để xem thu dây.

artifacts.controls: Six annotations only; per-effect MD and combined MD downloads. Existing interactive prototype behavior retained.

comparisonLimits: Magnific source timing/physics studied read-only2026-10-23. Fiora palette/layout and current connector/menu/canvas behavior follow user requests; no claim of active-generation frame parity.
Old automatic Connect sample still has900ms target pulse and26 dots; live drag M02 is the approved1300ms one-ring/max8-dot version.
No AI backend, persistence, production error simulation, or per-inserted-node generation. Demo uses supplied photo as result.
Historical shimmer/list-wire/Safari reference variants are not current active UI. Reference-only values are explicitly separated.
